title: Ether, DeFi fall twice as hard as bitcoin as equities selloff resumes
content: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% since midnight UTC as the stock selloff resumes, with ether (ETH) and DeFi tokens falling about twice as far.

title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
content: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

title: Gold's haven status has lost its edge over bitcoin, and the Fed's to blame
content: Gold has lost the risk-adjusted advantage that made it this year's haven of choice over bitcoin. Both now offer negative one-year Sharpe ratios, leaving cash yields hard to beat.

title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
content: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

title: Ukraine passes bill to legalize crypto and tax profits at 23%
content: Ukraine’s parliament passed a crypto regulation bill after three years of legislative work, with the new rules set to take effect in July 2027.

title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
content: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
content: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

title: Bitcoin ETFs near $5B in record monthly outflows amid AI stock rout
content: US spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $4.94 billion in November net outflows, exceeding the previous monthly record of $4.51 billion set in June.

title: Bitcoin price may fall below $53K if bear-market history repeats
content: Bitcoin price downside targets focused on the $53,200 realized price as research saw pointed to bear-market patterns continuing for BTC/USD.

title: Florida Man Jailed for Using AI to Pose as Streamer N3ON in $260K Crypto Scam
content: David Anthony Sanchez posed as the streamer to persuade a meme coin project's organizers to pay him for a fake endorsement deal.

title: Hyperliquid Leads Altcoin Losses as Bitcoin Slips Below $59K
content: HYPE fell more than 8% after Abraxas Capital pulled out of Hyperliquid, while U.S. Bitcoin ETFs' November outflows passed $4.9 billion.

title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
content: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.

title: OpenAI and Anthropic Insiders Fear Their Next AI Models Are Too Dangerous to Release
content: Employees at both AI labs reportedly question whether their strongest models should ever reach the public, as researchers struggle to keep increasingly capable systems under control during training and testing.

title: Anthropic’s Claude Ship Lets AI Write, Review and Approve Its Own Code
content: Anthropic’s new coding tools can review and repair software changes before approving them for release, leaving development teams to decide when a human still needs to check the AI’s work.
